summary: This is an 8-K filed by VanEck Avalanche ETF under Item 8.01 (Other Events) to announce a routine cash distribution of $140,003 from staking rewards to shareholders. There are no special-situation elements such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC action, or management change. The filing is simply a periodic distribution notice, and therefore does not qualify as a special situation.
